Saturday of the week above. Reading of the Acts of the Apostles. In those days, when some days had passed, [as far as] he is to proclaim light to the people and to the Gentiles. Gospel according to Luke, chapter XCIII. The disciples, coming to John (Jesus), as far as and they were filled.

Second week after Pentecost. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed John the apostle. Dearly beloved, God is love, as far as he should love his brother also. Gospel according to Luke, chapter CXCIII. There was a certain rich man, and he was clothed.

On the 8th day before the Kalends of June. Feast of Saint Urban, bishop and confessor. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The Lord gave praise to his holy one, as far as among the blessed he will be blessed. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter CCLXIII. Jesus said to his disciples: Watch therefore, as far as he will set him over all his goods.

Tuesday of the week above. Reading of the Acts of the Apostles. In those days, as Paul the apostle was speaking and making his defence, as far as and they let it fall away. Gospel according to John, chapter CLUn. Jesus, looking at his disciples, said, as far as but that you keep them from evil.

Wednesday of the week above. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Colossians. Brothers, put to death your members which are upon the earth, as far as and Christ in all. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter XXIII. Jesus said to his disciples: Do not think that I have come to abolish the law, as far as he will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

On the 5th day before the Kalends of June. At Paris, the deposition of Saint Germanus, bishop and confessor, and the translation of the body of Saint Gentianus, martyr of the people of Amiens. Reading of the book of Wisdom. He who keeps justice will hold fast its meaning, as far as abides always in the commandments of God. Gospel according to John, chapter CXXXIX. Jesus said to his disciples: This is my commandment, as far as whatever you ask the Father in my name he may give you.

On the 4th day before the Kalends of June. At Trier, the deposition of Saint Maximus, bishop. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Lord, father and ruler of my life, as far as looking into hidden parts. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter CCLXIII. Jesus said to his disciples: Watch therefore, as far as he will set him over all his goods.

On the 3rd day before the Kalends of June. Feast of Saint Petronilla. Reading of the book of Wisdom. But to the Lord God all things were known before they were created, as far as and in my elect a thousand roots. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter CXL. Jesus said to his disciples: The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden, as far as new and old.

Third week after Pentecost. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed John the apostle. Dearly beloved, do not wonder if the world hates you, as far as but in deed and in truth. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter XXXV. Jesus said to his disciples: Unless your justice abounds, as far as and then coming you shall offer your gift.

Monday of the week above. Reading of the Acts of the Apostles. In those days, when light began to dawn, as far as they put on board the things that were needed. Gospel according to Luke, chapter XCVI. Jesus said to his disciples: There was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple, as far as neither will they believe if someone rises from the dead.

Tuesday of the week above. Reading of the Acts of the Apostles. In those days, after [three] months, we sailed in an Alexandrian ship, as far as this is Jesus Christ the Son of God, through whom the whole world will begin to be judged. Gospel according to Luke, chapter CXCVII. Jesus said to his disciples: It is impossible that scandals should not come, as far as we have done what we ought to do.

On the 4th day before the Nones of June. At Rome, feast of Saints Marcellinus and Peter the exorcist, with forty-two others. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The souls of the just are in the hand of God, as far as their Lord will reign for ever. Gospel according to Luke, chapter CCXLVIII. Jesus said to his disciples: When you hear of battles, as far as in your patience you will possess your souls.

On the 3rd day before the Nones of June. At Orléans, the deposition of Saint Liphardus, priest. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Hebrews. Brothers, many were made priests, as far as by once offering himself, our Lord Jesus Christ. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter CCLXIX. Jesus told his disciples this parable: A certain man setting out on a journey abroad, as far as enter into the joy of your lord.

Friday of the week above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days John the apostle spoke, saying: Blessed is he who reads and who hears the words of this prophecy, as far as the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate. He who has an ear, as far as in the paradise of the Lord my God. Gospel according to Luke, chapter CLXXXI. Jesus told this parable: A certain man made a great supper, as far as shall taste my supper.

Saturday of the week above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days the Lord said: To the angel of the Church of Smyrna write, as far as before my Father and before his angels, as far as he who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the Churches. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter CCV. As Jesus was going out from Jericho, as far as they followed him.

Fourth week after Pentecost. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle. Dearly beloved, humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God, as far as to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Gospel according to Luke, chapter CLIXXVI. The tax collectors were drawing near to Jesus, as far as doing penance.

Monday of the week above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days the Lord said: To the angel of the Church of Philadelphia write, as far as I sat with my Father on his throne, and the rest. The Gospel that was on the Sunday of the same week.

Tuesday of the week above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days the four living creatures, casting their crowns before the throne, saying: Worthy are you, Lord, as far as who will be able to stand. The Gospel that [was] on the Sunday of the same week.
Here begin the readings of the fourth month.

Wednesday. At Saint Mary. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Love justice, you who judge, as far as and that which contains all things has knowledge of the voice. Likewise another. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord: Hear, Jacob, my servant, upon your offspring, as far as says the Lord almighty. Gospel according to Luke, chapter XCIII. The disciples, coming to Jesus, as far as they were filled.

Thursday of the week above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days I saw four angels standing upon the corners of the earth, as far as God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. The Gospel that [was] on the Sunday of the same week.
Friday. Reading of Joel the prophet. Thus said the Lord God: Rejoice, sons of Zion, as far as my people for ever, says the Lord almighty. Gospel according to Luke, chapter CLXXXVI.....

Saturday of the twelve readings. At Saint Peter. Reading of Joel the prophet. Thus says the Lord God: I will pour out of my spirit upon all flesh, as far as everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.

Likewise at the same place. Reading of the book of Leviticus. In those days the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: When you have entered the land, as far as in all your dwellings and generations, says the Lord almighty.
Likewise at the same place. Reading of the book of Deuteronomy. In those days Moses said: Hear, Israel, what I command you today, as far as the Lord your God shall have given you.
Likewise at the same place. Reading of the book of Leviticus. In those days the Lord said to Moses: If you walk in my precepts, as far as you will be my people, says the Lord almighty.

Likewise at the same place. Here Daniel the prophet is read. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Romans. Brothers, justified by faith, let us have peace with God, as far as through the Holy Spirit who has been given to us. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 205: As Jesus was going out from Jericho, as far as they followed him.

Fifth week after Pentecost. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Romans. Brothers, for I consider that the sufferings are not worthy, as far as awaiting the redemption of our body in Christ Jesus our Lord. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 56: Jesus said to his disciples: Be therefore merciful, as far as the speck from your brother's eye.

Fifth day before the Ides of June. Feast of Saints Primus and Felician. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Come over to me, all you who desire me, as far as but the beginning of faith is fastened to it. Gospel according to John, chapter 134: This is my commandment, as far as in my name, he may give [it] to you.

Ninth day before the Kalends of July. Vigil of Saint John the Baptist. Reading of Jeremiah the prophet. In those days the word of the Lord came to me, saying, as far as that you may build and plant, says the Lord almighty. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 1: There was in the days of Herod, king of Judaea, as far as a people made perfect.

Likewise on the day, the eighth before the Kalends of July. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord: Hear, you islands, as far as and the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you. Gospel according to Luke, chapter (3): At that time, now Elizabeth's time to give birth was fulfilled, as far as the redemption of your people.

Tuesday of the week mentioned above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days, when he had opened the seventh seal, as far as nor of their thefts. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter (36): Jesus said to his disciples: Agree with your adversary, as far as that your whole body go into Gehenna.
Seventh day before the Kalends of July. Vigil of John and Paul. Likewise on the day. Look up the epistle and Gospel that is among those of other saints.

Wednesday of the week mentioned above. Reading of the book of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, as far as they gave glory to the God of heaven. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 186: Tax-collectors and sinners were drawing near to Jesus, as far as doing penance.

Second day before the Ides of July. On the feast of Saints Basilides, Nabor, and Nazarius. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of love, as far as beauty for the adornment of his house. Gospel according to John, chapter 24: There was a man of the Pharisees, as far as may have eternal life.

Friday of the week mentioned above. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Apostle to the Colossians. Brothers, whatever you do in word or in deed, as far as the reward of the inheritance through Jesus Christ our Lord. Gospel according to Mark, chapter 120: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem into the temple, as far as whatever he says will happen, it will be done for him.

Saturday of the week above, eighteenth day before the Kalends of July. On the feast of Saint Felicula. Reading of the book of Wisdom. A lamp shining upon the holy lampstand, as far as he who sets a snare for another will perish in it. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 140: Jesus told his disciples this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden, as far as new and old.

Sixth week after Pentecost. Reading of the epistle of the blessed Peter the apostle. Dearly beloved, be all of one mind in prayer, as far as but sanctify the Lord Christ in your hearts. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 29: When the crowds pressed upon Jesus, as far as having left everything, they followed him.

Fourteenth day before the Kalends of July. Feast of Saints Mark and Marcellian and of Saint Marina, virgin. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The tongue of the wise adorns knowledge, as far as he who pursues justice is loved by the Lord. Gospel according to John, chapter 134: Jesus said to his disciples: This is my commandment, as far as in my name, he may give [it] to you.

Thirteenth day before the Kalends of July. Feast of Saints Gervasius and Protasius, Nazarius and Celsus, the boy. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Those who fear the Lord will not be unbelieving, as far as to the regard of him, the Lord our God. Gospel according to Luke, chapter (154): Jesus said to his disciples: Let your loins be girded, as far as over all that he possesses he will set him.

Fourth day before the Kalends of July. Vigil of the apostles Peter and Paul. Reading of the Acts of the Apostles. In those days Peter and John were going up into the temple, as far as at what had happened to him. Gospel according to John, chapter 227: At that time Jesus said to Peter: Simon, son of John, do you love me, as far as he was to glorify God.

Likewise on the day, the third before the Kalends of July. Reading of the Acts of the Apostles. In those days King Herod laid hands, as far as of the people of the Jews. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter (166): Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, as far as will be loosed in heaven.

Gospel according to Mark, chapter 117: When Jesus had gone out on the way, as far as come, follow me.

Fifth day before the Ides of November. The passion of Saint Theodore, martyr. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, as far as the clouds thicken with dew. Gospel according to John, chapter 134: This is my commandment, that you love one another, as far as they hated me without cause.

Fourth day before the Ides of November. At Rome, the deposition of Saint Leo, bishop, and of Saint Menas. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The tongue of the wise, as far as will be loved by the Lord. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 270: A dispute arose among the disciples, as far as the tribes of Israel.

Likewise the fourth weekday. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. In those days Isaiah the prophet said, It will be in the last days, as far as in the light of the Lord our God.

Likewise as above. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. In those days the Lord spoke to Ahaz, saying, as far as choose the good. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 3: The angel Gabriel was sent from God, as far as let it be done to me according to your word.

Sixth weekday. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, A rod shall come forth, as far as faithfulness the girdle of his loins. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 3: Mary rising up, as far as in God my saviour.

Likewise as above. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, The deserted land will rejoice, as far as springs of water, the Lord our God.
Likewise as above. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, Go up on a high mountain, as far as the Lord our God will lift them up in his bosom.

Likewise at Mass. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Colossians. Brothers, we ask you by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, as far as and will destroy by the brightness of his coming. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 3: In the fifteenth year, as far as and all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

Likewise as above. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Hebrews. Brothers, do not throw away your confidence, as far as to the saving of the soul.
Likewise a reading as above. Reading of Jeremiah the prophet. Behold, the days are coming, says the Lord, as far as into their own land, says the Lord almighty.

Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 3: When the mother of Jesus had been betrothed, as far as from their sins.

On the fifteenth day before the Kalends of December. The deposition of Saint Anianus, bishop and confessor, at Orléans. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The Lord led the just man, as far as eternal glory, the Lord our God. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 243: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, as far as will be saved.

O Lord my God, you have exalted upon the earth, as far as your name, O Lord our God. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 268: Jesus told his disciples this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like ten virgins, as far as nor the hour.

On the ninth day before the Kalends of December. The feast of Saint Clement, and of Saint Felicity, and of Saint Columban. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Blessed is the man who will dwell in wisdom, as far as the Lord our God will make him inherit. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 269: Jesus told his disciples this parable: A certain man setting out on a journey abroad, as far as into the joy of your lord.

Likewise a reading of the book of Wisdom. A valiant woman, as far as her works in the gates. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 130: While Jesus was speaking to the crowds, as far as is sister and mother.

On the eighth day before the Kalends of December. The feast of Saint Chrysogonus. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The just man gave his heart to keep watch, as far as it would be sought from generation to generation. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 249: Jesus said to his disciples, When you hear of battles, as far as your souls.

On the third day before the Kalends of December. The feast of Saint Saturninus. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Blessed is the man who was found without blemish, as far as the whole assembly of the saints. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 139: Jesus said to his disciples, See that no one leads you astray, as far as he will be saved.

On the second day before the Kalends of December. The feast of Saint Andrew. On the vigil. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Ephesians. Brothers, blessed be God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us, as far as he has abounded toward us. Gospel according to John, chapter 16: John was standing, and two of his disciples, as far as upon the Son of Man.

On the day. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Romans. For with the heart one believes unto justice, as far as their words. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 20: Jesus walking by the sea of Galilee, as far as they followed him.
And on the same day, Saint Ambrose.

On the Kalends of December. The deposition of Saint Eligius. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, as far as the clouds grow with dew. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 154: Jesus said to his disciples, Let your loins be girded, as far as the Son of Man comes.

On the fourth day before the Ides of December. At Rome, the deposition of Saint Damasus, pope. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Blessed is the man who was found without blemish, as far as the whole assembly of the saints. Gospel according to John, chapter 138: Jesus said to his disciples, This I command you, that you love one another, as far as who hated me without cause.

On the third day before the Ides of December. The feast of Saint Eulalia, virgin, and of the holy martyrs Victoricus, Fuscian and Gentianus. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Corinthians. Brothers, let him who glories glory in the Lord, as far as to present to Christ. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 218: Jesus told his disciples this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like ten virgins, as far as nor the hour.

Likewise a reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Romans. Brothers, we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, as far as delivered him up. Gospel according to John, chapter 138: Jesus said to his disciples, This I command you, that you love one another, as far as who hated me without cause.

On the second day before the Ides of December. The deposition of Saint Walaric, confessor. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The Lord led the just man, as far as eternal glory, the Lord our God. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 269: Jesus told his disciples, A certain man [setting out] abroad, as far as into the joy of your lord.

On the Ides of December. The deposition of Saint Autbert, bishop of Cambrai. And of Saint Lucy, virgin. Reading of the book of Wisdom. Wisdom conquers malice, as far as of the discipline of God. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 251: Jesus said to his disciples, Settle it in your hearts, as far as your souls.

On the fifteenth day before the Kalends of January. The feast of Saint Afra, virgin. Reading of the book of Malachi the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, Behold, I will send my angel, as far as the ancient years, says the Lord almighty. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 140: Jesus told his disciples this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like a hidden treasure, as far as new things and old.

On the twelfth day before the Kalends of January. At Rome, the deposition of Saint Innocent, bishop. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Romans. Brothers, who will separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord? Gospel according to Luke, chapter 45: Jesus coming down from the mountain, as far as is plentiful in heaven.

On the eleventh day before the Kalends of January. At Rome, between the two laurels, the feast of the thirty holy martyrs. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The just will live for ever, as far as the Lord our God will lead them. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 263: Jesus said to his disciples, Watch, as far as he will set him.

On the tenth day before the Kalends of January. At Nicomedia, the feast of the 860 holy martyrs. Reading of the book of Wisdom. The souls of the just, as far as peace to the elect of God. Gospel according to Mark, chapter 138: Jesus said to his disciples, See that no one leads you astray, as far as he will be saved.

On the eleventh day before the Kalends of January. In Cappadocia, the feast of the forty virgins. Reading of the Epistle of the blessed Paul the apostle to the Corinthians. Brothers, let him who glories glory in the Lord, as far as to present to Christ. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 40: Jesus told his disciples this parable: The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field, as far as new things and old.

For abundance of rain, or mildness of the air. Reading of Joel the prophet. Thus says the Lord, Do not fear, O land, as far as that he has done wonders with you. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 83: It happened on one of the days, as far as they obey him.

For lack of rain. Reading of Jeremiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, Have you utterly cast off Judah, as far as all these things, O Lord our God. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 160: Jesus said to his disciples, I have compassion on the crowd, as far as his disciples with him.

On a day of war. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. In those days Hezekiah fell ill, as far as I will protect him, says the Lord almighty. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 150: Jesus said to his disciples, Do not be anxious, as far as will be added to you.

On the feast of a pope. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to the Hebrews. Brothers, every high priest, as far as the order of Melchizedek. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 270: A dispute arose among the disciples, as far as the tribes of Israel.

At the ordination of deacons. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to Timothy. Dearest one, appoint deacons who are chaste, as far as in the faith which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. Gospel according to John, chapter 104: Jesus said to his disciples, Amen, amen I say to you, unless a grain of wheat, as far as who is in heaven.

At the ordination of a priest. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to Titus. Dearest one, Paul, a servant of Christ and an apostle, as far as sound teaching through Jesus Christ our Lord. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 263: Jesus said to his disciples, Watch therefore, as far as he will set him.

At the ordination of a bishop. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to Timothy. Dearest one, it is a faithful saying, if anyone [desires] the office of bishop, as far as of our God in all things. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 154: Jesus said to his disciples, Who, do you think, is the faithful servant? Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 166: Jesus came into the region of Caesarea Philippi, as far as loosed also in heaven.

At the dedication of a basilica or oratory. Reading of the Apocalypse of John the apostle. In those days I saw the holy city Jerusalem, as far as I make all things new. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 60: Jesus said to his disciples, There is no good tree that bears bad fruit, as far as it was founded upon the rock. Also the Gospel according to Luke, chapter 214: Jesus went out, as far as salvation has come to this house.

For blessing brides. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to the Corinthians. Brothers, do you not know that your bodies, as far as bear God in your body. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 261: Jesus was speaking with his disciples, as far as but few are chosen.
Also the Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 189: Jesus came into the territory of Judaea, as far as what God has joined together, let no man separate.

At the arrival of judges. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to Timothy. Brothers, I urge you first of all, as far as in faith and truth. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 268: Jesus told his disciples this parable: There was a certain nobleman; he had, as far as it will be given, and he will abound.
In tribulation or unrest. Reading of Jeremiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, Does [one] fall, as far as but the word of the Lord remains for eternity and for ever and ever.
Also of the same. Thus says the Lord God, Do judgement and justice, as far as their servants and people, says the Lord God.

Also of the same. If our iniquities have contended, as far as do not abandon us, O Lord our God. Gospel according to Luke, chapter 280: Jesus went out and was walking through Jericho, as far as to save what was lost.

On the feast of priests. Reading of the book of Malachi the prophet. Thus says the Lord, You will know that unless the commandment to you, as far as for he is the angel of the Lord of hosts. Gospel according to Mark, chapter 52: Jesus went about in the surrounding region, as far as the sick, and they will be healed.

Mass that a priest will sing for himself. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to the Romans. Brothers, we know that the law is spiritual, as far as of this, the grace of God through Jesus Christ our Lord. Gospel according to Matthew, chapter 76: Jesus went about all the cities, as far as every infirmity.
Votive Mass. Reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord, On that day a gift will be brought to the Lord, as far as my inheritance Israel, says the Lord almighty.
For the sick. Reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul [read: James] the apostle. Brothers, is any of you sad, as far as pray for one another, that you may be saved.
For travellers. Reading of the book of Genesis. In those days Abraham spoke, saying, The Lord of heaven, who took me from the house, as far as he himself will send his angel before you.
In the office for the dead. Reading of the book of Maccabees. In those days the most valiant man Judas, as far as that they may be loosed from sins.

Also a reading of the Epistle of blessed Paul the apostle to the Thessalonians. Brothers, we do not want you to be ignorant concerning those who sleep, as far as therefore comfort one another with these words in Christ Jesus our Lord.

Also a reading of Isaiah the prophet. Thus says the Lord God, Your light will rise in the darkness, as far as for the mouth of the Lord has spoken. Gospel according to John, chapter 94: Martha said to Jesus, as far as who has come into this world.
Also the Gospel according to John, chapter [...]: Jesus said to his disciples and to the crowds of the Jews, For as the Father raises the dead, as far as from death into life.
Also according to John, chapter 56: Jesus said to the crowds of the Jews, All that [the Father] gives me, as far as on the last day.
Also according to John, chapter 65: Jesus said to his disciples and to the crowds of the Jews, I am the living bread, as far as on the last day.
READINGS FOR THE DEAD.
I. Spare me, Lord, for my days are nothing, as far as I shall not stand.
II. My soul is weary of my life, as far as can deliver.
III. Your hands, as far as has guarded my spirit.
IV. Answer me, how many iniquities do I have? as far as a garment that is eaten by the moth.
V. Man born of woman, living for a short time, as far as until the desired [day] comes.
VI. Who will grant me this, that you protect me in the underworld, as far as but spare my sins.
VII. My spirit will grow weak, my days will be shortened, as far as my patience is yours, O Lord my God.
VIII. With my flesh consumed, to my skin, as far as they are carved in flint.
IX. For I know that my Redeemer lives, as far as this my hope [is laid up] in my bosom.
